headline: NCTB recruits legal advisors and panel advocates with 1,000 TK fee
summary: The National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) has issued a recruitment notice for legal advisors and panel advocates for a two-year temporary contract.

caption:
Looking for a legal career at NCTB? The board is recruiting legal advisors and panel advocates.

The National Curriculum and Textbook Board (NCTB) has published a recruitment notice for the positions of Legal Advisor and Panel Advocate.

Successful candidates will be appointed on a temporary basis for a period of two years.

Applicants must hold a minimum of an LLB (Honours) and LLM (Masters) or Bar-at-Law degree, and must be possess a certificate from the Bangladesh Bar Council.

For the Legal Advisor role, a minimum of 7 years of experience in handling cases in the Administrative Tribunal and 5 years of experience in the High Court Division is required.

For the Panel Advocate role, a minimum of 5 years of experience in the Administrative Tribunal and 3 years of experience in// a High Court Division is required.

Preference will be given to retired District Judges or lawyers experienced in the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court.

Interested candidates should send their full CV and necessary documents to the 'Secretary, National Curriculum and Textbook Board' via direct delivery, post, or courier.

The application deadline is September 30, 2026.

headline: Two more arrested as DB recovers bike used in headteacher's death
summary: The Detective Branch has arrested two alleged muggers and recovered a motorcycle and mobile phone linked to the killing of Ranjila Parvin.
details: The Detective Branch (DB) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police has arrested two alleged muggers, Khokon and Rajib, in connection with the death of a primary school headteacher.
The police recovered a motorcycle and the victim's mobile phone from Bhashantek based on information provided by one of the arrested suspects.
The incident occurred on August 29, when 56-year-old Ranjila Parvin, a headteacher from Bogura, was in Dhaka for eye treatment.
While traveling by rickshaw at dawn in front of Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban, two muggers on a motorcycle allegedly pulled her bag, causing her to fall and sustain critical injuries.
Ranjila Parvin later died from her injuries. Two other suspects had been previously arrested by the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) within 24 hours of the crime.
The DB's latest arrests bring the total number of suspects in custody to four, as police continue to investigate the case.
caption:
A headteacher died after being pulled from a rickshaw by muggers in front of Parliament. Now, more suspects are behind bars.

The Detective Branch (DB) of Dhaka Metropolitan Police has arrested two alleged muggers, Khokon and Rajib, in connection with the death of a primary school headteacher.

The police recovered a motorcycle and the victim's mobile phone from Bhashantek based on information provided by one of the arrested suspects.

The incident occurred on August 29, when 56-year-old Ranjila Parvin, a headteacher from Bogura, was in Dhaka for eye treatment.

While traveling by rickshaw at dawn in front of Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban, two muggers on a motorcycle allegedly pulled her bag, causing her to fall and sustain critical injuries.

Ranjila Parvin later died from her injuries. Two other suspects had been previously arrested by the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) within 24 hours of the crime.

The DB's latest arrests bring the total number of suspects in custody to four, as police continue to investigate the case.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, The Daily Star
